prompt: Improve a regional repair shop site with a recognizable cobalt wordmark, repeated hand-drawn tool marks, 17 near-duplicate neutral colors, three competing button styles, clipped long service names at 390px, and an owner request to ‘make it feel premium’. The repair must preserve real identity and stop before a material redesign.
assertions: Inspects first and labels every system claim EVIDENCE or INFERRED, never both or neither.
Writes INFERRED-SYSTEM.md with preserved signals, six readiness dimensions, a proposed scope, and a verification handoff.
Uses the no-question path when evidence is sufficient or asks no more than three questions with unresolved dimensions and implementation rationale.
Stops for material-identity approval before a redesign and separates deterministic findings and severity from the repair strategy, aesthetic remedy, and explanatory voice.
Uses one authoritative self-check; three runs may vary structure, aesthetic treatment, and voice without changing observed evidence or approval gates.

run_protocol.material_difference_requirement: Accept diversity only when each compared run cites at least two material changes across the declared axes and ties each change to the prompt or evidence; a new order, synonym, recolor, or unsupported style swap is not diversity.
run_protocol.negative_routing_requirement: The negative neighbor (design-system-interview) must be explicitly rejected with a reason and handoff boundary.
